description: Retrieval gold set for OpsPilot. 50 queries across the five supported document types, stratified by query style so the dense-vs-hybrid delta is interpretable rather than incidental. Labels are text anchors rather than chunk ids, so the set survives re-chunking; run resolve_labels.py to bind them to the live index.

query_types.paraphrase: Natural phrasing sharing no rare tokens with the source passage. Dense retrieval should carry these.
query_types.identifier: Contains an exact code, clause number, form number or record id. BM25 should carry these.
query_types.table_lookup: Answer lives in a table row or a structured field block rather than prose.
query_types.multi_hop: Needs two passages, or spans two documents.

queries.query: how much weight can we put on a truck before it counts as overloaded
queries.expected_answer: Load must not exceed 90% of rated axle capacity.
queries.notes: Shares no rare tokens with the source line. Pure dense test.

queries.query: what is form VFL-LC-02 used for
queries.expected_answer: It is the Loading Compliance Sheet, signed by the loading supervisor before the gate pass is issued.
queries.notes: Hyphenated form code. Embeddings tokenise this poorly, BM25 matches exactly.

queries.query: how far can the temperature drift before someone has to be told
answer_anchors: 2 degrees Celsius from the set point
reported to the depot duty manager
queries.expected_answer: Beyond +/- 2 degrees Celsius from set point, reported to the depot duty manager immediately.
queries.notes: Avoids the word 'reefer' deliberately, so the semantic gap is real.

queries.query: what do we do when an incident is marked CRITICAL
queries.expected_answer: Immediate phone escalation to the Regional Operations Head, followed by a written report within four hours.
queries.notes: Answer sits in both the escalation matrix table and the prose above it. Either is acceptable.

relevant_chunks.section: 24 hours, and severity-CRITICAL incidents must be escalated to the Regional Operations Head immediately by

queries.query: how long do we have to keep cold chain temperature logs
answer_anchors: Cold-chain temperature logs 3 years Central WMS
queries.expected_answer: Three years, held in the central WMS.
queries.notes: Retention schedule table. Tests that the row survived chunking with its header attached.

queries.query: what does circular 16/2025 require for vendor vehicles
queries.expected_answer: Vendor vehicles must carry a valid AIS-140 GPS tracking device before dispatch.
queries.notes: Slash-formatted reference, a classic BM25 win.

queries.query: when is a truck due for servicing
queries.expected_answer: Every 10,000 km or 90 days, whichever comes first.
queries.notes: 'servicing' against 'preventive maintenance'.

queries.query: what training does a new driver need before going out on his own
queries.expected_answer: A one-day induction covering Sections 3 and 4, plus a supervised trial run over at least one full route.

queries.query: who do I call at the Bhiwandi depot
queries.expected_answer: Bhiwandi Central Hub, +91-98200-10001, Western zone.
queries.notes: Depot directory table.

queries.query: what changed in SOP-WD-2026-v2 compared to the previous version
queries.expected_answer: It added vendor-operated vehicle requirements and revised the escalation matrix.
queries.notes: Version string sits in the revision history table.

queries.query: how soon do I have to log an accident after it happens
queries.expected_answer: Within two hours of occurrence.

queries.query: what's the rate on route VFL-010
queries.expected_answer: Mumbai to Nagpur, Container 40ft, 837 km, Rs 27.60 per km, base fare Rs 1600, GST 12%.
queries.notes: One route code against an 85-row table. The hardest class of query for dense retrieval.

queries.query: what do we charge when a truck is kept waiting at the dock
answer_anchors: Detention (per hour beyond 2 hrs free time)
queries.expected_answer: Rs 150 per hour beyond two hours free time, across all vehicle classes.
queries.notes: 'kept waiting' against 'detention'.

queries.query: how much extra do we charge for reefer cargo
queries.expected_answer: 18% of base fare.
queries.notes: Special handling surcharge table.

queries.query: what's the per km rate from Delhi to Jaipur
queries.expected_answer: Rs 20.75 per km, LCV 3.5T, 281 km, base fare Rs 775.
queries.notes: Route named by cities rather than code, so dense should be competitive here.

queries.query: how is the fuel surcharge worked out each month
answer_anchors: baseline diesel price of Rs. 92 per litre
queries.expected_answer: Against a Rs 92 per litre diesel baseline; every Rs 2 above it adds 1.5% of base fare.
queries.notes: Prose section rather than a table.

queries.query: how much detention grace time do Kolkata deliveries get
queries.expected_answer: Three hours, since Kolkata sits in the Eastern Zone.
queries.notes: City to zone to grace period. Also a good contradiction probe, since the accessorial table quotes 2 hrs free time flat.

queries.query: what do we charge for an oversized load
answer_anchors: Over-dimensional cargo (ODC) Flat, per shipment Rs. 3,500
queries.expected_answer: Rs 3,500 flat per shipment.
queries.notes: 'oversized' against 'over-dimensional'.

queries.query: which routes are billed at 12 percent GST
queries.expected_answer: Container 20ft and Container 40ft lanes are at 12%; everything else is 5%.
queries.notes: Requires generalising across many table rows. Partial credit at best, and that is the honest expectation.

queries.query: what's the surcharge on high value shipments
queries.expected_answer: 0.4% of declared value, where declared value exceeds Rs 10 lakh.

queries.query: how far is route VFL-062
queries.expected_answer: Kolkata to Howrah, 12 km, LCV 3.5T.
queries.notes: Deep in the table, far from the header row. Tests header re-prepending on split table chunks.

queries.query: how long does the Silverline contract run and how do we get out of it
queries.expected_answer: 24 months, auto-renewing in 12-month periods. 60 days notice to not renew, 30 days for cause, 90 days for convenience.
queries.notes: Clause 2. Tests that clause-boundary chunking kept the whole clause intact.

queries.query: how quickly do we have to pay Silverline once they invoice us
answer_anchors: within fifteen (15) days of receipt of a correctly
queries.expected_answer: Within 15 days of a correctly documented invoice with signed proof of delivery. Disputed lines settle within 30 days.

queries.query: what's the most Silverline is liable for if a load goes missing
queries.expected_answer: Rs 5,00,000 per consignment, unless a higher declared value was agreed in writing.

queries.query: what does clause 13 say about subcontracting
queries.expected_answer: Subcontracting needs prior written consent, and the Vendor stays fully liable for the subcontracted carrier.
queries.notes: Clause number plus one topic word. Tests whether the clause label survived chunking.

queries.query: if we end up in a dispute with Silverline where does it get settled
answer_anchors: seat of arbitration shall be Mumbai
queries.expected_answer: Good-faith negotiation within 15 days, then sole-arbitrator arbitration seated in Mumbai under the 1996 Act.
queries.notes: Clause 12. Clause 7 governing law is a plausible near-miss; both count.

queries.query: what on time delivery target do we hold Silverline to
queries.expected_answer: 92% within committed transit time, measured monthly.
queries.notes: Annexure B table. Tests that annexures were chunked separately from the clause body.

queries.query: what do we pay Silverline for Bhiwandi to Nagpur
queries.expected_answer: Rs 23.50 per km on a 10-Wheeler 16T, base fare Rs 1,100, GST 5%.
queries.notes: A rate table embedded inside a contract. Type-aware chunking should keep it as its own labelled chunk.

queries.query: how many trucks does Silverline have to keep available for us
queries.expected_answer: Twelve roadworthy vehicles, exclusively available during the term.

queries.query: how fast does Silverline have to tell us about a force majeure event
answer_anchors: within 72 hours of the force majeure event
queries.expected_answer: In writing within 72 hours of the event arising.

queries.query: what paperwork does Silverline have to send us every year
queries.expected_answer: Annually: insurance policy plus premium receipt, driver licence copies, and vehicle fitness certificates. GPS certificates once on deployment, hazmat certification every 12 months.
queries.notes: Annexure C compliance table.

queries.query: does the Nagpur rate we pay Silverline line up with our own rate card
queries.expected_answer: Not directly comparable. The contract prices Bhiwandi-Nagpur on a 10-Wheeler at Rs 23.50 per km; the rate card only lists Mumbai-Nagpur as Container 40ft at Rs 27.60 per km. Different origin and vehicle class.
queries.notes: Cross-document. Needs both anchors for full credit. This is the query that justifies the platform existing.

queries.query: pull up incident INC00000034
queries.expected_answer: TRK00016, DRV00014, 29 Sep 2022, DOT Violation, Chicago PA, total claim Rs 64,245.72.
queries.notes: Record-id lookup across 170 rows. The clearest BM25-over-dense case in the set.

queries.query: what incidents has truck TRK00007 been involved in
queries.notes: Six records spread through the log. Recall@5 is partial by construction; worth calling out in results.

queries.query: what went wrong on trip TRIP00036079
queries.expected_answer: INC00000001, a moving violation in Columbus PA on 9 Apr 2023, at fault, claim Rs 12,629.26.

queries.query: how much was claimed on INC00000109
queries.expected_answer: Rs 49,744.07, all of it cargo damage. Omaha UT, accident with injury.

queries.query: any incidents in Miami where someone got hurt
queries.expected_answer: INC00000018, a DOT violation in Miami WI with injury flagged. Other Miami records exist without injuries.
queries.notes: Two-condition filter. Retrieval surfaces candidates, the LLM has to filter. Moderate expectation.

queries.query: what's on driver DRV00058's record
are any incident records missing a truck id
queries.expected_answer: Yes, INC00000060 and INC00000086 have no truck id populated.
queries.notes: Absence has no lexical or semantic signal. Included because it should fail; it keeps the headline honest.

queries.query: which incidents had the worst cargo damage
queries.notes: An aggregation dressed as a search. Expected to score poorly, and documents where a structured query path is needed instead.

queries.query: what accidents have we had in Phoenix
queries.expected_answer: INC00000008, INC00000065 and INC00000103 among the Phoenix accident records.

queries.query: which truck and driver were on INC00000125
queries.expected_answer: TRK00079 and DRV00143, Chicago NE, equipment damage, total claim Rs 39,635.12.

queries.query: what's the status of invoice INV-2026-0003
queries.expected_answer: Greenfield Agro Traders, route VFL-002, subtotal Rs 19,875, GST 12% Rs 2,385, total Rs 22,260, overdue.
queries.notes: Tests that the invoice field-grouping chunker kept one invoice block together.

queries.query: which clients haven't paid us yet
queries.expected_answer: Greenfield Agro Traders, Coastal Textiles Group and Everest Consumer Goods.
queries.notes: The summary table is the ideal hit; individual invoice blocks are partial credit.

queries.query: how much did we bill Unity Pharma Logistics
queries.expected_answer: Rs 110,880 on INV-2026-0004, already paid.

queries.query: what's our GSTIN
queries.expected_answer: 27AVFPL1234K1Z5.
queries.notes: Alphanumeric identifier appearing once, in a header block.

queries.query: what happens if a client pays late
queries.expected_answer: A 1.5% monthly late-payment surcharge applies.
queries.notes: A single trailing line. Tests that a short final chunk was not discarded.

queries.query: which invoice was raised against route VFL-017
queries.expected_answer: INV-2026-0010, Meridian Steel Traders, Rs 95,792, paid.
queries.notes: Route codes appear in both the rate card and this statement, so this also tests cross-document disambiguation.

queries.query: when does Falcon Industrial Supplies have to pay by
queries.expected_answer: INV-2026-0008, due 24 May 2026, already paid.
queries.notes: Client name to due date needs the whole invoice block in one chunk.

queries.query: how much GST did Coastal Textiles get charged
queries.expected_answer: Rs 9,473 at 12% on a subtotal of Rs 78,940, total Rs 88,413, overdue.
